provenance.generator: gen_graphs.py (pure integer incidence/degree/Euler/connectivity checks; no floats)
provenance.complete_for: k=9 branch, r<=U, abstract triangulated dual disk: M1 (1), M2 (4), P4 (20), P3 (16), P2 (4), T2 (4); T3 (7) reproduced for completeness and marked lead-owned

conventions.rings: 0..8; anchor i sits between ring i and ring (i+1)%9
conventions.anchors: 9 anchors, anchor i = boundary spoke with outer triangle (i, (i+1)%9, labels[i])
conventions.faces: triples; list = 9 outer triangles + inner (1 ring + 2 hubs) + optional central (3 hubs)
conventions.primal_edges: 2-subsets occurring in a face; the 9 anchor pairs are the boundary edges

consumption.network_graph: network_graph.network_edges(faces) with nsites=9+m: anchor node nf+i joins (i,(i+1)%9); face node nsites+j joins faces[j]
consumption.not_in_this_file: per-graph rational edge weights and the 9 reference angles theta are NOT here; this file is structural only (lead's generalized certifier proposes/verifies them)
